summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated 700KB bundle under it
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (v1.3.13), unzips it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js — a single-line ~727KB '@bun @bun-cjs' bundle that is heavily obfuscated (string-array with a scrambled-alphabet decoder function; no source maps). setup.mjs itself is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (identifiers like _0x488df8, literal-hiding lookup objects). The package presents as a React component library scoped under @servicetitan (main is dist/index.js), and neither the Bun runtime download nor the obfuscated math_init.js payload relates to the advertised UI-component functionality. Because the payload executes under a freshly fetched Bun runtime rather than under Node, Node-based install-time sandboxes and scanners do not observe the code that actually runs on the installer's machine at npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
